title: Building, Releasing, and Maintaining an API knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which topic is explicitly listed in the syllabus coverage for “Building, Releasing, and Maintaining an API”?
questions.explanation: The attached FastAPI syllabus lists “Preparing a production configuration” under this lesson. The remaining syllabus subtopics are preserved in the lesson file for complete coverage.

questions.prompt: According to the worked example in “Building, Releasing, and Maintaining an API”, which result should the learner verify?
options: The lifespan setup runs before requests are served and cleanup runs at shutdown.
The app publishes itself to production and passes all tests automatically.
HTTP 500 is returned for every valid request.
Input validation and authorization are disabled by design.
questions.answer_key: The lifespan setup runs before requests are served and cleanup runs at shutdown.
questions.explanation: The worked example explicitly documents this expected result. Reproduce it locally in the listed environment before treating it as tested behavior.

questions.prompt: Which approach best supports advanced FastAPI engineering here? (Building, Releasing, and Maintaining an API)
options: Use a documented contract, test edge cases and verify behavior under the relevant constraints
Assume one process-local variable synchronizes every replica
questions.answer_key: Use a documented contract, test edge cases and verify behavior under the relevant constraints
questions.explanation: Advanced extensions still need stable contracts, boundaries, tests and verified failure behavior.
